item: a 401/403 robots.txt is robots_refused, never robots_denied (C1)
refs: PR #1979; OPEN_QUEUE C1 (2026-09-17 pipeline carried defects)
summary: The source preflight filed a robots.txt the host refused to serve (401/403) under robots_denied, the verdict of an explicit Disallow, and wrote robots_allowed=False. It is now robots_refused, listed apart in the summary with its own log line, for the homepage's robots.txt and for a ping hop whose RobotsUnavailable cause is refused; robots_allowed stays unknown (NULL). Fail-closed unchanged: no ping, the fetcher still refuses the site. Also fixed: a source's FIRST check that learned nothing stored robots_allowed=True, the column default, because the ORM drops a None with a default from the INSERT; it now stores NULL.
